oneLiner: 相对性原理 + 光速不变原理：所有惯性系物理定律相同，真空中光速恒为 c。
oneLinerEn: Relativity + light-speed invariance: laws are same in all inertial frames; c is constant.
detail: 由爱因斯坦于 1905 年提出，颠覆了绝对时空观。
detailEn: Einstein (1905) overturned absolute space and time.

detail: 粒子加速器中的不稳定粒子寿命因此被显著延长。其中 Δt 为运动参考系测得的时间，Δt₀ 为静止参考系的原时，v 为相对速度，c 为光速。
detailEn: Unstable particles in accelerators live longer as predicted. Δt moving-frame time, Δt₀ rest proper time, v relative speed, c light speed.

oneLiner: 运动方向上的长度变短：L=L₀√(1−v²/c²)。
detail: 其中 L 为运动参考系测得的长度，L₀ 为静止时的原长，v 为相对速度，c 为光速。
detailEn: L measured in the moving frame, L₀ the rest length, v relative speed, c light speed.

detail: 核反应释放的能量正来自质量的微小亏损。其中 E 为能量，m 为质量，c 为光速。
detailEn: Nuclear energy comes from tiny mass defects. E energy, m mass, c speed of light.

term: 广义相对论与时空弯曲
oneLiner: 引力被诠释为时空的弯曲，物质告诉时空如何弯曲。
oneLinerEn: Gravity is spacetime curvature caused by mass-energy.
detail: 预言了光线偏折、引力红移、黑洞与引力波，均已被观测证实。
detailEn: Predicts light bending, gravitational redshift, black holes and waves — all observed.

oneLiner: 两件事是否「同时」发生取决于观察者的运动状态，没有绝对的全域此刻。
oneLinerEn: Whether two events are simultaneous depends on the observer's motion; there is no universal now.
detail: 高速行驶的列车上，车头车尾两道闪电对车上的人可能不同时、对站台的人却可能同时；时间与空间随参考系而重新划分。
detailEn: Lightning at a fast train's front and rear may be non-simultaneous to riders yet simultaneous on the platform; time and space are re-parted by each frame.

oneLiner: 引力与加速度在局部不可区分，这是广义相对论的基石。
oneLinerEn: Gravity and acceleration are locally indistinguishable—the cornerstone of general relativity.
detail: 在密闭电梯里，人无法分辨是静止于地面还是在深空被匀加速；既然加速度可使光线弯曲，引力也必然使光线弯曲，由此走向时空的几何。
detailEn: In a sealed lift one cannot tell rest on Earth from uniform acceleration in deep space; since acceleration can bend light, gravity must too—leading to the curved geometry of spacetime.

oneLiner: 引力越强、时钟走得越慢；山脚的表比山顶的略慢。
oneLinerEn: The stronger the gravity, the slower clocks run; a clock at a mountain's foot lags one at its peak.
detail: 近大质量天体处时间流逝变缓，这正是全球定位卫星必须校正的效应，也是电影里「天上一日、地上一年」的物理雏形。
detailEn: Time slows near mass—precisely the correction orbiting position satellites need, and the physics behind 'a day up high, a year below' in film.

oneLiner: 物体速度越接近光速，加速它越难，等效惯性随之增大。
oneLinerEn: The closer to light speed, the harder to accelerate—an effective rise in inertia.
detail: 随速度升高，动量增长快于经典预期，任何有质量的物体都无法被推到光速；这解释了粒子加速器里电子越飙越「重」。
detailEn: Momentum grows faster than classical physics expects with speed, so no massive body can be pushed to light speed—why electrons in accelerators feel ever heavier as they race.
